scalars.scalar_value: RECRUITMENT PERIOD ONE MONTH: Applicants will be screened on a weekly basis. The position can be filled prior to the removal date.
Knowledge and Experience using VMACS medical record keeping system.

Experience to provide oversight of professional DVM students and animal health technicians in all aspects of canine and feline emergency medicine, including experience to provide constructive feedback to technicians and students regarding compliance with policies and procedures and the importance of documentation and record keeping.
Hours to be arranged. To include nights, weekends and holidays.

items.item_text: Current California Veterinary Medicine License or a CA University License.
Board certified, residency trained or a minimum of 5 years of experience in emergency medicine.

Experience to provide oversight of professional DVM students and animal health technicians in all aspects of canine and feline emergency medicine, including experience to provide constructive feedback to technicians and students regarding compliance with policies and procedures and the importance of documentation and record keeping.
Knowledge and Experience using VMACS medical record keeping system.
Experience to provide high quality service to all constituents.

Under general direction, primarily receive, stabilize and treat canine and feline emergency and urgent care patients with the assistance of the Emergency and Critical Care Service faculty and residents when needed. Teach and train professional veterinary students, interns, and technicians in providing small animal emergency and urgent care.
Current knowledge of veterinary medicine as it applies to the diagnosis and treatment of diseases.
Knowledge of the VMTH policies and procedure.
Excellent oral and written communication skills to effectively interact in a constructive manner with a variety of faculty, staff and students, as well as people from the community.
